items.prompt: Why is an all-zero first row wrong?

options.why: An empty source needs j insertions to form a target prefix of length j, so the row must be 0,1,2,... .
Equality of later characters cannot make an empty source equal to a nonempty prefix.
The row stores prefix edit costs; neither strings nor rows are sorted by this algorithm.
Unequal-character substitution costs one, and substitutions cannot create characters from an empty source.

items.explanation: The base is the edit count for the empty source.
